يستظهرا (form X)
# يَسْتَظْهِرَا (yastaẓhirā) /jas.taðˤ.hi.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
# يُسْتَظْهَرَا (yustaẓharā) /jus.taðˤ.ha.raː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَظْهَرَ (istaẓhara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
